text:
aisha_cs: Good morning — kicking off Sunrise onboarding thread. Quick framing: success criteria = prod inference (hosted) with SLOs < 300ms p95, data ingest + secure keys, and first customer-facing demo by milestone week 6. Can we confirm stakeholders and any immediate blockers?

ben_ae: I’m the account lead. Stakeholders on the customer side: Evan (infra lead), Priya (security), and Maya (product). I’ll intro them in email after this thread.

carlos_pm: From product: two must-haves — (1) end-to-end prompt routing working with Redwood API, (2) basic cost dashboard cards in Console.

dina_se: SE here — we need API key access, sample dataset, and schema for embed/rerank flows. Can @evan_it drop S3 details or an allowlist?

ev an_it: evan_it: I can share a staging S3 bucket and open a VPC peering ticket. Security wants to vet before keys are pushed. ETA for docs: EOD Tue.

frank_success: Frank (onboarding ops) — proposing timeline: week 0 kickoff, week 1 infra & keys, week 2 model routing + test calls, week 3 embed index + evals, week 4 canary/demo, week 6 full demo + success signoff. Flags: renewal touchpoint at week 8 if not live.

aisha_cs: Sounds good. Two coordination asks: 1) enablement sessions (SE-led) for customer devs — propose 60m sessions on API and Console; 2) feedback loop — weekly short pulse + shared doc for blockers.

dina_se: I can run the SE sessions. Proposed slots next Tue/Thu 10am PT. Agenda: quick API call, streaming, tool-calls, cost controls.

ben_ae: @aisha_cs please add an enablement invite for both slots and include the customer calendar. I’ll own the renewal check-ins.

carlos_pm: Success metrics to capture before signoff: 1) p95 latency <300ms on typical payloads, 2) embedding recall > 0.7 on our eval set, 3) deploy automation for model pinning + rollback. Add these to the playbook.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: create shared doc at https://docs.redwood.ai/sunrise/onboard (auto-created).

aisha_cs: For feedback capture — we’ll run a 3-question weekly pulse: ease-of-integration, latency acceptability, open blockers. Frank will collate and share Friday mornings.

ev an_it: Security note from Priya: must use customer KMS for keys in private deployment. That adds ~5 business days to infra prep. Flagging for timeline.

frank_success: Action items (quick):
- ben_ae: intro email to customer stakeholders (today)
- evan_it: share S3 + KMS constraints (EOD Tue)
- dina_se: prep SE session deck + sample calls (Mon)
- carlos_pm: upload eval set and acceptance thresholds to playbook (Wed)
- aisha_cs: create weekly pulse doc and calendar cadence (today)

ben_ae: noted. If KMS extends infra, propose swapping week2/3 tasks so we can still get model routing tested on hosted variant earlier.

aisha_cs: Agreed — plan for hosted fallback in week2 if private prep delays. That preserves demo timeline.

dina_se: Quick config snippet for the SE session (will paste into deck):
```
# sample curl for test call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

carlos_pm: One more risk: if feature gating for cost dashboards isn’t granted by infra, we’ll demo a manual CSV export instead. Not ideal but acceptable for signoff.

aisha_cs: Thanks everyone. Can participants react with :thumbsup: once they confirm the proposed timeline and roles? I’ll send a summarized kickoff note after we have confirms.

ben_ae: :thumbsup:

carlos_pm: :thumbsup:

dina_se: :thumbsup:

ev an_it: :thumbsup:

frank_success: Logged the actions in the onboarding playbook and pinged the SRE queue for VPC/KMS tasks. Will update the thread with the calendar invites.

aisha_cs: Closing the thread for now — will follow up with the summary and invites. If anything urgent, DM me. Thanks!
